Donate Now Upcoming Events 15-Feb-2019 | 08-00 AM 90 FT Idol Inauguration In Penugonda Participate in this historic event where The World's Tallest 90 Ft Pancha Loha Idol of Vasavi Mata will be consecrated 07-Nov-2018 | 08-00 AM Deepavali In Vasavi Dham, Penugonda Celebrate the victory of good over evil this Deepavali at Vasavi Dham under the presence of Goddess Vasavi 19-Oct-2018 | 09-00 AM Navrathri In Vasavi Dham, Penugonda Celebrate Sharan Navarathri at Vasavi Dham with Goddess Vasavi, the reincarnation of Goddess Adi Para Shakti The Story of India’s Oldest Apostle of Non-Violence Story of Vasavi Goddess Vasavi is an incarnation of Goddess Adi Parashakthi. She took birth to spread the principles of love and non-violence and help a cursed gandharva prince (A Shapa Grastha Gandharva) who takes birth as King Vishnuvardhana attain salvation. She devotes her life to be in service of Lord Shiva and vowed to remain celibate as a Gowrabalika. King Vishnuvardhana, who was served by her father as a tributary king, was captivated by her beauty and desired to marry her. Due to her fierce resistance to his desire, he decides to marry her even if that necessitated waging a war against her father. To prevent blood-shed and uphold the dignity and honor of women, Goddess Vasavi decides to offer herself to the sacred fire. She performs agni-pravesham along with families of the 102 Gotrajas giving birth to the Arya Vysya Community and becomes a shining beacon of non-violence. From this sacrificial fire, she displays her Vishwa Roopam and preaches the Shapta Shati Mantra . She advises the Arya Vysya community to lead a life of non-violence and to practice agriculture, commerce and gau Raksha (dairy and cow protection) blessing the community with prosperity and abundance. This day is celebrated every year across the World as Vasavi Vishwa Roopam Day or Agni Pravesham Day during the month of February on Magha Shuddha Dwitiya Bharath Ratna Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, Past President of India, has indeed very rightly described Goddess VASAVI as the first ever known embodiment of non-violence in the world. Her path of non-violence was later tread by Jesus Christ, Goutam Buddha, Mahatma Gandhi, Satya Sai Baba, Potti Sri ramulu of Andhra Pradesh and Martin Luther King. Know more about Vasavi Mata? https://vasavipenugonda.com/vasavidham.p.text: :: Akhila Bharath Sri Vasavi Penugonda Temple Trust :: Akhila Bharath Sri Vasavi Penugonda Temple Trust Home Overview Overview News Newsletter Services Vasavidham Story Donations Annadanam Go- Shala E Hundi Trustees Gallery Photos Videos Contact THE TRUST AND DHAM Home VasaviDham The Trust was formed exclusively to develop the only Punya Kshetra for Arya Vysyas and to spread global awareness of Goddess Vasavi Mata’s significance, Story and Birth Place. Aims & objectives of the Trust To develop Penugonda on par with Kasi, Tirumala, Annavaram,Bhadrachalam, Simhachalam etc., To provide accommodation, free food, free Hostels and Hospitals To build Vasavi Rishi Gothra Suvarna Mandir. To install world's tallest 90 ft. tall Panchaloha idol of Matha Vasavi.In the sanctum sanctorum of Vasavi Rishi Gothra Suvarna Mandir To preach & spread the principles of non-violence, love, peace and sacrifice amongst the to the world. To inspire Vysyas spread all over the world to visit Penugonda at least once during their life time. To finalise the history of Penugonda & Pooja vidhanas, Astothara /Sahasra Namavali of Vasavi and to adopt the same in all Vasavi Temples worldwide. To start Veda Patasala, Guru Peetam, Educational Institutions, up todeemed University, Old Age Home, Widow rehabilitation Centre. To perform free Marriages and To setup libraries for in depth study of Vasavi charithra etc., Projects Completed 90 Ft High Pancha Loha Idol 90 Ft high Pancha Loha idol, the tallest of its kind in the world. This idol has been installed in the 185 ft. high Golden Temple. The uniqueness of this idol is that it is a free standing idol and can has been built to withstand an earthquake of 8 on the richter scaler. Bramhanda Kiranas emitting from this sacred idol will fulfill the ambitions of the devotees. Devotees have rare opportunity to partake by liberal contributions. Vasavi Suvarna Rishi Gotra Mandir Central to Vasavi Shanthi Dham is the 185 Ft high Vasavi Suvarna Rishi Gotra Mandir featuring 102 Rishi Gothra Stambhas. These will be erected symbolising 102 Gothras, along with the respective Gothraja Couple who entered Agni pravesham along with Matha Vasavi. This has been beautifully written and described by Sri Bhagavan Veda Vyasa Maharshi in KANYAKA PURANAM which comes in ‘OORUJOPAAKHYAANA’ of SKAANDA PURANA. Corresponding verse with respect to each Gothra will be inscribed in multiple languages on the respective Rishi Gothra Stambha. VIP Block and Board Room The VIP Room Block is a set of Thirteen 3-Star Level State of the Art suite rooms that is air conditioned and feature modern amenities. The VIP Room Block has elevator access and also feature a Modern Board Room for the trust's meetings and activities. Completed Projects 8 acres purchased at Penugonda to build Punya Kshetra The land was leveled and various projects are developed here and this “ HOLY PLACE ” has been named as “ Vasavi Shanthi Dham” Year 2004 AsthaBhuja Pushkarini with Musical Fountain The Astha Bhuja Pushkarini is modeled on the lines of an Eight Petaled Lotus and thus the name Astha Bhuja (Eight Petals or Eight Shoulders). It also features a musical fountain that jives to devotional tunes. Teppotsavam for Goddess Vasavi is done here during various festive ceremonies. 9 Feb 2005 Subharam Nityannadana Hall The Subharam Nityannadana Hall can cater to over 100 people in a single sitting and has been serving free meals to devotees since it was opened. Over one crore meals have been served at the Nityannadana Hall. It was one of the first projects to be completed. 31 Jan 2006 102 Crore Vasavi Nama Likhita Yagna Stupam As the name suggests, the 102 Crore Vasavi Nama Likhita Yagna Stupam features contains actual booklets containing the names of Vasavi written 102 Crore times by actual devotees. The Stupam buzzes with the very essence of her name To date , books with over 60 lakh inscriptions of Goddess Vasavi’s name: Om Vasavambayay Namaha, have been deposited into the Stupa. March 2006 Vasavi Mandir Vasavi Mandir is home to a marble idol of Goddess Vasavi. Over 10 Arjitha Sevas performed on a daily basis including GoPuja, DampatiPuja, Kumkumarchana, Abhishekam, Teppotsavam, Deepotsavam, Homas etc. on special occasions. The Mandir is also home to Vasavi Chakram and Sri Chakram and nitya poojas are performed. Special Alankaras are performed to the Goddess to fulfil devotees desires to see her in all her splendor. 7 May 2006 Navagraha Dampathis at Navagraha Vanam The Navagraha Dampathis are unique compared to what you will find in a normal Indian Temple. Here, a separate temple has been built for each of the Navagraha Devathas – Surya, Chandra, Mangala, Budha, Guru, Shukra, Shani, Rahu and Ketu. More importantly, they are present alongside their consorts or wives. Temples for Consorts of Navagrahas are very rarely found in India. 7 May 2006 Tulasi Brundavanam The power of the Tulsi Plant has been discussed in Indian mythology for long. And each of our homes feature the Tulasi Brundavanam. Befitting its significance and the size of Vasavi Dham, a huge brundavanam has been built to house the holy Tulsi plant. 7 May 2006 Free Hospital Philanthropy is at the heart of what we stand for. With this in mind, a Free hospital has been built to cater to the people of Penugonda. The hospital features consulting doctors who treat common ailments and other ailments. Consultation and medicines are dispensed free of cost. 16 September 2006 Free Kalyana Mantap The Free Wedding Hall at Vasavi Dham to provide eligible devotees and eligible Arya Vysyas a free hall to perform their wedding ceremonies under the abode of Goddess Vasavi. It houses close to 10 rooms and is attached to the Nityannadana Hall (dining hall) and kitchen making it a full fledged wedding hall with ability to cater to good size weddings. Those eligible Arya Vysyas who desire to get married at Vasavi Shanthi Dham, the Trust provides a free mangalyam ( of upto 5 Grams Gold), free dresses for the groom, free sarees for the Bride and free food for over 300 people. In the days to come, the trust plans to perform mass marriages at the Kalyan Mantap 21 Jan 2007 Fully furnished AC Suites, AC Rooms, Double Rooms & Dormitories The Dham’s Accommodation Complex houses over 40 rooms and 3 dormitories. Drop Telephone in the amenities list and add the following: An Additional block of VIP Rooms along with a Board Room and Pantry is expected to be completed by January 2017. Jan 2007 Vasavi Agni Kundam Artistically modeled with flames around it, the Agni Kundam is a symbolic depiction of the sacrificial fire of Goddess Vasavi. Devotees can offer Havis in the days to come. 21 July 2007 Suvarna Addala Mandapam The Suvarna Addala Mandapam or Golden Mirror Minaret is a one of its kind sanctuary built to depict scenes from the life of Goddess Vasavi in a colorful and engaging manner. The Mandapam features Guru Bhaskaracharya, Goddess Vasavi’s Parents as well as a model of the 102 feet High Suvarna Rishi Gotra Mandir with a special light and mirror show to enchant us. The Addala Mandapam is made from chequered glass. Over 57600 devotees have visited this since its opening in 2008. 10 September 2008 90 Ft high Pancha Loha idol This is a model of the 90 Ft high Pancha Loha idol , the tallest of its kind in the world, that will be installed within the 142 ft high Rishi Gotra Mandir. Idol is made with Gold, Silver, Copper, Tin & Zinc. Idol making has already begun. > 10 September 2008 Bank Building The Bank Building was built to provide visiting devotees with easy access to banking facilities. The Bank Building houses the local branch of Kotak Mahindra Bank. 10 September 2008 Pavitra Vasavi Snana Ghattam The Snana Ghattam or Bathing Ghats as they are known are modeled on the lines of the Pana Nasanam bathing ghats of Tirumala. Artistically built to simulate the feeling of bathing under a natural waterfall or fountain, it evokes the divinity within us. The Snana Ghattam was consecrated with water from the 7 Seas (Sapta Sagaras) and 30 Rivers. It has separate changing rooms are provided for Men and Women. During the recent Godavari Pushkaras, over 50,000 devotees have taken a holy bath here. 4 May 2009 Free Hostel This facility is for poor rural students, who find it difficult to continue to their education due to lack of financial support from parents. With proper guidance and education, we feel the students would be able to mould their future and have a better standard of living. 31 Jan 2014 25,000 Litre Capacity Water Tank This massive water tank has been installed at Vasavi Shanthi Dham. This is used for drinking and cooking purposes only. Care has been taken that not a single drop of water passes out of the premises. 24 Aug 2015 50 KW Solar Power Plant The Trust has taken the pioneering initiative to install a 50 KW Solar Plant. https://vasavipenugonda.com/story.php.text: :: Akhila Bharath Sri Vasavi Penugonda Temple Trust :: Akhila Bharath Sri Vasavi Penugonda Temple Trust Home Overview Overview News Newsletter Services Vasavidham Story Donations Annadanam Go- Shala E Hundi Trustees Gallery Photos Videos Contact THE STORY OF GODDESS VASAVI KANYAKAPARAMESWARI Home Story Click Here Download Vasavi Kanyakaparameswari Purana in Kannada Telugu version coming soon PENUGONDA, the abode of VASAVI, is situated on the banks of the GAUTAMI RIVER which was one of the seven tributaries of the Sacred Godavari and it is the place where GREAT SAINTS performed YAGNA and penance. It is here the great saint Pulasthya was successful in achieving the simultaneous visual manifestation of the three deities, Brahma, Vishnu and Maheswara. Penugonda is also the place where God KUMARASWAMY (Skanda) performed penance and Guru Bhaskaracharya envisioned the manifestation of Brahma. Later on, Penugonda become the abode of LORD LAKSHMINARAYANA who went on to be known as KONAKOMALA JANARDHANA and PARVATHI PARAMESWARA who went on to become GOWRI NAGARESWARA. PENUGONDA IS LOCATED IN WEST GODAVARI DIST OF ANDHRA PRADESH. Vasavi Maatha's Historic Events Vidya Vachaspathi, Lalitha Kalanidhi, Kavi Brahma, Vasavi Gnana Sagara Sri Kollipara Panduranga Rao of Chirala, AP has carried out intensive research on the life and times of Goddess Vasavi Mata. He has examined several ancient source texts and has held extensive discussions about this with several researchers and has provided us an insight into this. Based on the source Purana "Vysya Purana Kavyamu" authored by Goddess Vasavi's Guru Sri Bhaskaracharya, her birth is estimated to have taken place on Friday, Vaisakha, Shuddha Dashami under the Punarvasu Star in the year 2617 BC (Julian). She is supposed to have performed "Agni Pravesham" along with the 102 Gotraja Couples and provided Viswa Roopa darsanam on Thursday, Magha, Shuddha Dwiteeya in the year 2628 BC (Julian). She also advised the Vasavi Sapta Shathi to all devotees at this time. Renowned Astrologer Divyashree Bobrulu Rosaiah Siddhanti has authored a book in support of the above date and time. In addition, Sri Ekkirala Vedavyasa has reviewed horoscopes and planetary positions and has further endorsed the above dates. Siddhanti Sri Lakshmikant Shresthi has also endorsed the above dates and has further advanced that Goddess Vasavi's life was contemporaneous with Lord Buddha's. Sri Vankadhari Nageswara Rao Shresthi has also supported this claim in his feature "Goddess Vasavi Kanyakaparameswari's" Life and Times in the Vasavi Sravanthi Magazine. Goddess Vasavi's Life has been discussed in 9th Century AD works that discuss the history of 27 Chalukya Vishnuvardhana's lives and times. Hence, when we celebrate Vasavi Jayanthi or Vasavi Atmarpana Day, we calculate that from the year of her birth and her Agni Pravesham. Hence, in the year 2018, we celebrated the 4636th Vasavi Jayanthi (2018+2617 = 2635). Goddess Vasavi's Story The Vysya community consisted of 714 Gotrajas who lived happily in Penugonda Kingdom under the able rule of King Kusuma Shresti and Queen Kusumamba. King Kusuma Shresti who was 16th in the line of kings who succeeded SAMADHIMUNI was childless. As per Guru Bhaskaracharya’s advice they performed ‘PUTRAKAMESTI YAGNA’. Goddess PARASHAKTHI appeared from the HOMAKUNDAM and blessed the couple with payasam. Kusumamba consumed the payasam with devotion and on VAISHAKA SHUDDHA DASHIMI day, she gave birth to twins - A boy, named Virupaksha who was an incarnation of God Nandikeswara and, a girl, Vasavi, an incarnation of Goddess ADIPARASHAKTI. Virupaksha attained proficiency in Dharmashastra, politics and martial arts. Vasavi was taught Fine Arts and Music. From her childhood, she was an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva. She was a teenage girl of exceptional beauty. She decided to dedicate her life to Lord Shiva and remain unmarried as Gowrabalika. King Kusumashresti was a tributary King to Emperor Vishnuvardhana who visited Penugonda. The Emperor received a rousing welcome by the King Kusuma Shresti and the people of Penugonda looked at him with awe and reverence. Vishnuvardhana was captivated by the astounding beauty and glamour of Vasavi and decided to marry her at any cost. His desire was like a death blow to Kusuma Shresti. King Kusumashresti called a meeting of the elders of 714 Gotra and discussed the matter in detail. Under the guidance of Guru Bhaskaracharya, they all decided to give importance to the views of Vasavi. Royal couple, Guru Bhaskaracharya, Vasavi and Virupaksha had a secret meeting. Vasavi at this stage told that she wanted to uphold the dignity and honour of womanhood and was born with a purpose to preach non-violence (Ahimsadharma) to the world. She exhibited her original form of Adiparashakti and vowed that she would remain a virgin. On hearing that Vasavi had declined to marry him, Vishnuvardhana deiced to marry her even by waging a war on Penugonda. In order to prevent bloodshed and to uphold the dignity and honour of womanhood, Vasavi decided to end her AVATAR by offering herself to the God of fire – AGNI. Out of the 714 Gotrajas, 102 Gotrajas supported her view and decided to enter the sacred fire alongwith her. Fearing persecution from Vishnuvardhana, the remaining 612 Gotrajas ran away from Penugonda to save their lives. Malhara, a great sculptor built 103 Homakundas for the sacred occasion. On MAGHA SUDDHA BIDIGE day, Vasavi entered the Sacred Fire along with the 102 Gotraja Vasavi emerged from the sacred fire as ‘KANYAKAPARAMEWARI’, and displayed her original form of ‘ADIPARASHAKTHI’ with eighteen hands - ASTA DASA BHUJA and preached Universal and Social Religiousness, Spirituality, Love, Sacrifice and Non-Violence and laid the foundation for Global Unity through non-violence and dharma rakshana. This day is celebrated as ‘ATMARPANA DAY’ on a large scale across all ‘VASAVI TEMPLES’. The 102 GOTRAJA COUPLES who entered the sacred fire along with Vasavi were pardoned of their curses of 16 generations and given MOKSHA by VASAVI. This astonishing news reached Emperor VISHNUVARDHANA who was on his way to Penugonda and his head broke into thousands of pieces and died. The sons of the 102 Gotra Couple who entered fire went to KASI to perform last RITES and brought 102 SHIVALINGAS and installed these SHIVALINGAS at prominent place in Penugonda city. To this date, this street is known as LINGALA VEEDHI. Virupaksha was crowned as the King of Penugonda by Raja Raja Narendra, son of Vishnuvardhana and provided excellent facilities to the citizens to lead a happy life. Bharath Ratna Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, Past President of India, has indeed very rightly described Goddess VASAVI as the FIRST ever known embodiment of NON-VIOLENCE in the world. Her path of non-violence was later tread by Jesus Christ, Goutam Buddha, Mahatma Gandhi, Satya Sai Baba, Potti Sriramulu of AP and Martin Luther King. https://vasavipenugonda.com/about.php.text: :: Akhila Bharath Sri Vasavi Penugonda Temple Trust :: Akhila Bharath Sri Vasavi Penugonda Temple Trust Home Overview Overview News Newsletter Services Vasavidham Story Donations Annadanam Go- Shala E Hundi Trustees Gallery Photos Videos Contact About Home About The Trust and Dham The Trust was formed exclusively to develop the only Punya Kshetra for Arya Vysyas and to spread global awareness of Goddess Vasavi Mata’s significance, Story and Birth Place. Aims & objectives of the Trust 1. To develop Penugonda on par with Kasi, Tirumala, Annavaram,Bhadrachalam, Simhachalam etc., 2. To provide accommodation, free food, free Hostels and Hospitals 3. To build Vasavi Rishi Gothra Suvarna Mandir. 4. To install world's tallest 90 ft. tall Panchaloha idol of Matha Vasavi.In the sanctum sanctorum of Vasavi Rishi Gothra Suvarna Mandir 5. To preach & spread the principles of non-violence, love, peace and sacrifice amongst the to the world. 6. To inspire Vysyas spread all over the world to visit Penugonda at least once during their life time. 7. To finalise the history of Penugonda & Pooja vidhanas, Astothara /Sahasra Namavali of Vasavi and to adopt the same in all Vasavi Temples worldwide. 8. To start Veda Patasala, Guru Peetam, Educational Institutions, up todeemed University, Old Age Home, Widow rehabilitation Centre. 9.To perform free Marriages and To setup libraries for in depth study of Vasavi charithra etc., Projects Under Construction 90 Ft High Pancha Loha Idol 90 Ft high Pancha Loha idol, the tallest of its kind in the world, will be installed within this 185 ft high Rishi Gotra Mandir. Idol is made with Gold, Silver, Copper, Tin & Zinc. Idol making has already begun. This idol will be installed in the 185 ft. high Golden Temple. Bramhanda Kiranas emitting from this sacred idol will fulfill the ambitions of the devotees. Devotees have rare opportunity to partake by liberal contributions. This 90 ft. tall Panchaloha idol weighs around 40 tons and Nijapaadas(holy feet) ,which were installed on August 27, 2016, alone weigh 1.55 tons. The whole idol will be goldplated. Vasavi Suvarna Rishi Gotra Mandir Central to Vasavi Shanthi Dham is the 185 Ft high Vasavi Suvarna Rishi Gotra Mandir featuring 102 Rishi Gothra Stambhas. These will be erected symbolising 102 Gothras, along with the respective Gothraja Couple who entered Agni pravesham along with Matha Vasavi. This has been beautifully written and described by Sri Bhagavan Veda Vyasa Maharshi in KANYAKA PURANAM which comes in ‘OORUJOPAAKHYAANA’ of SKAANDA PURANA. Corresponding verse with respect to each Gothra will be inscribed in multiple languages on the respective Rishi Gothra Stambha. VIP Block and Board Room The VIP Room Block is a set of Thirteen 3-Star Level State of the Art suite rooms that will be air conditioned and feature modern amenities. The VIP Room Block will have elevator access and also feature a Modern Board Room for the trust's meetings and activities. This project is expected to be completed by Sep-Oct 2018 timeframe. Completed Projects 8 acres purchased at Penugonda to build Punya Kshetra The land was leveled and various projects are developed here and this “ HOLY PLACE ” has been named as “ Vasavi Shanthi Dham” Year 2004 AsthaBhuja Pushkarini with Musical Fountain The Astha Bhuja Pushkarini is modeled on the lines of an Eight Petaled Lotus and thus the name Astha Bhuja (Eight Petals or Eight Shoulders). It also features a musical fountain that jives to devotional tunes. Teppotsavam for Goddess Vasavi is done here during various festive ceremonies. 9 Feb 2005 Subharam Nityannadana Hall The Subharam Nityannadana Hall can cater to over 100 people in a single sitting and has been serving free meals to devotees since it was opened. Over one crore meals have been served at the Nityannadana Hall. It was one of the first projects to be completed. 31 Jan 2006 102 Crore Vasavi Nama Likhita Yagna Stupam As the name suggests, the 102 Crore Vasavi Nama Likhita Yagna Stupam features contains actual booklets containing the names of Vasavi written 102 Crore times by actual devotees. The Stupam buzzes with the very essence of her name To date , books with over 60 lakh inscriptions of Goddess Vasavi’s name: Om Vasavambayay Namaha, have been deposited into the Stupa. March 2006 Vasavi Mandir Vasavi Mandir is home to a marble idol of Goddess Vasavi. Over 10 Arjitha Sevas performed on a daily basis including GoPuja, DampatiPuja, Kumkumarchana, Abhishekam, Teppotsavam, Deepotsavam, Homas etc. on special occasions. The Mandir is also home to Vasavi Chakram and Sri Chakram and nitya poojas are performed. Special Alankaras are performed to the Goddess to fulfil devotees desires to see her in all her splendor. 7 May 2006 Navagraha Dampathis at Navagraha Vanam The Navagraha Dampathis are unique compared to what you will find in a normal Indian Temple. Here, a separate temple has been built for each of the Navagraha Devathas – Surya, Chandra, Mangala, Budha, Guru, Shukra, Shani, Rahu and Ketu. More importantly, they are present alongside their consorts or wives. Temples for Consorts of Navagrahas are very rarely found in India. 7 May 2006 Tulasi Brundavanam The power of the Tulsi Plant has been discussed in Indian mythology for long. And each of our homes feature the Tulasi Brundavanam. Befitting its significance and the size of Vasavi Dham, a huge brundavanam has been built to house the holy Tulsi plant. 7 May 2006 Vasavi Homa Kundam The Homa Kundam is where homas and other holy ceremonies are performed for regular homas. The Homa Kundam is quite large is capable of supporting large ceremonies that are to be done on a huge scale. At least 20 couples can seat themselves comfortably and homas are performed on a daily basis. 7 May 2006 Free Hospital Philanthropy is at the heart of what we stand for. With this in mind, a Free hospital has been built to cater to the people of Penugonda. The hospital features consulting doctors who treat common ailments and other ailments. Consultation and medicines are dispensed free of cost. 16 September 2006 Free Kalyana Mantap The Free Wedding Hall at Vasavi Dham to provide eligible devotees and eligible Arya Vysyas a free hall to perform their wedding ceremonies under the abode of Goddess Vasavi. It houses close to 10 rooms and is attached to the Nityannadana Hall (dining hall) and kitchen making it a full fledged wedding hall with ability to cater to good size weddings. Those eligible Arya Vysyas who desire to get married at Vasavi Shanthi Dham, the Trust provides a free mangalyam ( of upto 5 Grams Gold), free dresses for the groom, free sarees for the Bride and free food for over 300 people. In the days to come, the trust plans to perform mass marriages at the Kalyan Mantap 21 Jan 2007 Fully furnished AC Suites, AC Rooms, Double Rooms & Dormitories The Dham’s Accommodation Complex houses over 40 rooms and 3 dormitories. Most of the rooms are air-conditioned. Drop Telephone in the amenities list and add the following: An Additional block of VIP Rooms along with a Board Room and Pantry is expected to be completed by January 2017. Jan 2007 Vasavi Agni Kundam Artistically modeled with flames around it, the Agni Kundam is a symbolic depiction of the sacrificial fire of Goddess Vasavi. Devotees can offer Havis in the days to come. 21 July 2007 Suvarna Addala Mandapam The Suvarna Addala Mandapam or Golden Mirror Minaret is a one of its kind sanctuary built to depict scenes from the life of Goddess Vasavi in a colorful and engaging manner. The Mandapam features Guru Bhaskaracharya, Goddess Vasavi’s Parents as well as a model of the 102 feet High Suvarna Rishi Gotra Mandir with a special light and mirror show to enchant us. The Addala Mandapam is made from chequered glass. Over 57600 devotees have visited this since its opening in 2008. 10 September 2008 90 Ft high Pancha Loha idol This is a model of the 90 Ft high Pancha Loha idol , the tallest of its kind in the world, that will be installed within the 142 ft high Rishi Gotra Mandir. Idol is made with Gold, Silver, Copper, Tin & Zinc. Idol making has already begun. 10 September 2008 Bank Building The Bank Building was built to provide visiting devotees with easy access to banking facilities. The Bank Building houses the local branch of Kotak Mahindra Bank. 10 September 2008 Pavitra Vasavi Snana Ghattam The Snana Ghattam or Bathing Ghats as they are known are modeled on the lines of the Pana Nasanam bathing ghats of Tirumala. Artistically built to simulate the feeling of bathing under a natural waterfall or fountain, it evokes the divinity within us. The Snana Ghattam was consecrated with water from the 7 Seas (Sapta Sagaras) and 30 Rivers. It has separate changing rooms are provided for Men and Women. During the recent Godavari Pushkaras, over 50,000 devotees have taken a holy bath here. 4 May 2009 Free Hostel This facility is for poor rural students, who find it difficult to continue to their education due to lack of financial support from parents. With proper guidance and education, we feel the students would be able to mould their future and have a better standard of living. 31 Jan 2014 25,000 Litre Capacity Water Tank This massive water tank has been installed at Vasavi Shanthi Dham. This is used for drinking and cooking purposes only. Care has been taken that not a single drop of water passes out of the premises. 24 Aug 2015 50 KW Solar Power Plant The Trust has taken the pioneering initiative to install a 50 KW Solar Plant. This would generate 70,000 units of electricity per year and help in the saving Rs 7.70 lakh in electricity cost per year.
